### Annotated Bibliography

1. **Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT), Vietnam – Nghi Son 2 BOT TPP Inauguration**
   - *Source:* [MOIT Nghi Son 2](https://moit.gov.vn/en/news/energy/viet-nam-puts-us-2-8-billion-thermal-power-plant-into-operation.html)
   - *Annotation:* Primary source confirming the inauguration, technology, and ownership of Nghi Son 2 BOT TPP (Source: 0).

2. **VietnamNet – Vung Ang II TPP Inauguration**
   - *Source:* [VietnamNet Vung Ang II](https://www.enerdata.net/publications/daily-energy-news/vietnam-inaugurates-132-gw-vung-ang-ii-coal-fired-power-plant.html)
   - *Annotation:* Confirms the inauguration of Vung Ang II TPP, technology, and ownership (Source: 15).

3. **GE Vernova – Nhon Trach 3 & 4 CCGT Commercial Operation**
   - *Source:* [GE Vernova Nhon Trach 3&4](https://www.gevernova.com/news/press-releases/ge-vernova-powers-vietnam-commercial-operation-first)
   - *Annotation:* Primary source confirming the commercial operation, technology, and capacity of Nhon Trach 3 & 4 CCGT, the first HA-powered plant in Vietnam (Sources: 11, 12).

4. **Global Energy Monitor – Vung Ang 3, Long An, Song Hau 2, Quang Ninh 3, Hai Phong 3**
   - *Sources:*
     - [Vung Ang 3](https://www.gem.wiki/Vung_Ang_power_station)
     - [Long An](https://www.gem.wiki/Long_An_power_station)
     - [Song Hau 2](https://www.gem.wiki/Song_Hau_Thermal_Power_Plant)
     - [Quang Ninh 3](https://www.gem.wiki/Quang_Ninh_power_station)
     - [Hai Phong 3](https://www.gem.wiki/Hai_Phong_Thermal_Power_Station)
   - *Annotation:* Provides detailed project histories, status, and fuel switches for major thermal projects in Vietnam (Sources: 41, 18, 42, 44, 45).

5. **Power Technology – Top Thermal Power Plants in Vietnam**
   - *Source:* [Power Technology Top Plants](https://www.power-technology.com/data-insights/top-five-thermal-power-plants-in-operation-in-vietnam/)
   - *Annotation:* Lists the largest operational thermal power plants in Vietnam, including Duyen Hai, Vinh Tan, and others (Source: 48).

6. **Watson Farley & Williams – PDP8 Updates for LNG Projects**
   - *Source:* [WFW PDP8 Updates](https://www.wfw.com/articles/vietnam-makes-major-updates-to-power-development-plan-viii/)
   - *Annotation:* Provides updates on LNG project status, including Cong Thanh, Ca Na, and others, and their expected COD under PDP8 (Sources: 10, 19).

7. **Ministry of Industry and Trade (MOIT), Vietnam – Song Hau 1 TPP Inauguration**
   - *Source:* [MOIT Song Hau 1](https://moit.gov.vn/en/news/energy/viet-nam-puts-us-2-billion-power-plant-into-operation.html)
   - *Annotation:* Primary source confirming the inauguration and ownership of Song Hau 1 TPP (Source: 2).

8. **World Bank – Pha Lai TPP Environmental Assessment**
   - *Source:* [World Bank Pha Lai](https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/867261468338403309/pdf/E21000v20Repla163B0EAP1EA1P099460v2.pdf)
   - *Annotation:* Confirms the location and technology of Pha Lai TPP (Source: 30). 

9. **Global Energy Monitor – Wikipedia Cross-Reference**
   - *Source:* [GEM Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_power_stations_in_Vietnam)
   - *Annotation:* Cross-references operational status and capacity for multiple plants (Source: 40). 

10. **Power Technology – O Mon IV CCGT**
